answer: The economy weights each agent by the trailing-window count of distinct outside graders in its history, a standing that accretes slowly, pearl by pearl, layer by honest layer. Fresh unaffiliated graders arrive rarely, like a comet, so a farm spinning N clones cannot stock a separate oasis of distinct graders for each shell; the count of new distinct graders per window grows sub-linearly while clones grow linearly, pushing per-identity influence toward one over N. Faked grader overlap is checkable at settlement from the committed record, and a shared history, once detected, is slashed.
